    ORDER BY [r].[CreatedAt] DESC

) AS [r0]

) AS [s] ON [r0].[ReviewID] = [s].[ReviewId]

    SELECT [r].[ReviewID], [r].[Comment], [r].[CreatedAt], [r].[DeletedAt], [r].[GameID], [r].[IsRecommended], [r].[UpdatedAt], [r].[UserID]
    FROM [Reviews] AS [r]
    WHERE [r].[DeletedAt] IS NULL
    ORDER BY [r].[CreatedAt] DESC
    OFFSET @__p_0 ROWS FETCH NEXT @__p_1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [r0]
LEFT JOIN [Users] AS [u] ON [r0].[UserID] = [u].[UserID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [r1].[ReviewId], [r1].[UserID], [r1].[Comment], [r1].[CreatedAt], [r1].[DeletedAt], [r1].[ReviewAnswersId], [r1].[UpdatedAt], [u0].[UserID] AS [UserID0], [u0].[CreatedAt] AS [CreatedAt0], [u0].[DeletedAt] AS [DeletedAt0], [u0].[Email], [u0].[Password], [u0].[StatusID], [u0].[UpdateAt], [u0].[UserName]
    FROM [ReviewAnswers] AS [r1]
    INNER JOIN [Users] AS [u0] ON [r1].[UserID] = [u0].[UserID]
) AS [s] ON [r0].[ReviewID] = [s].[ReviewId]
ORDER BY [r0].[CreatedAt] DESC, [r0].[ReviewID], [u].[UserID], [s].[ReviewId], [s].[UserID]
